title: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-16
summary: Tri Pointe Homes, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results from its annual meeting (April 15, 2026) and special meeting (April 16, 2026). All six director nominees were elected, executive compensation advisory votes passed, and stockholders approved a merger with Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. (Japanese parent) via Merger Sub Teton NewCo, Inc. This is a corporate governance filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Annual meeting (April 15, 2026): all six director nominees elected with votes ranging from 52M to 67M for
Say-on-pay advisory vote: 55.6M for, 12.2M against (advisory vote to be held annually going forward)
Auditor ratification: Ernst & Young LLP approved as independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal 2026
Special meeting (April 16, 2026): merger agreement with Sumitomo Forestry Co., Ltd. and Teton NewCo, Inc. approved
Merger Sub is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sumitomo Forestry (Japanese kabushiki kaisha)
